from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialLineItem(BaseModel):
    """A financial statement line item extracted from a single document."""
    registrant_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company or entity filing the report")
    account_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact name of the financial line item (e.g., 'Accounts payable and accrued expenses')")
    amount_value: float | None = Field(description="The numerical amount reported for this line item")
    amount_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit or scale of the amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands')")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period end date")
    text_context: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the label and amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_line_items: list[FinancialLineItem]
